qsm-web opensrc get.description: Acquire a library's source by package spec or repository address into one directory per library, and print what was acquired

args.name: target
args.description: a package spec (bare, scoped, registry-prefixed, owner/repo, or version-pinned) or a repository address

args.name: project
args.description: resolve the spec against this project's declared dependencies

qsm-web doctor.description: Report each web bin's health, and whether the Tavily CLI, the Tavily skills and the Context7 skill are present, naming the fix for each that is not

qsm-web searxng search.description: Search the instance named by --instance or QSM_SEARXNG_INSTANCE and print the results as one JSON array

args.name: query
args.description: the query words, joined with spaces

args.name: numResults
args.description: how many results to keep (default 10)

args.name: profile
args.description: source selection: server defaults, personal sites/discussions, academic publications, technical sources, image/icon/art discovery, video metadata links, regional news, music catalog, place/geocoding links or narrow file indexes; exclusive with --engines

args.name: engines
args.description: restrict to these engines, comma separated; an empty value sends none

args.name: timeRange
args.description: how far back results may reach

args.name: language
args.description: result language, e.g. en

args.name: safesearch
args.description: 0 off, 1 moderate, 2 strict

args.name: instance
args.description: the instance to query (default $QSM_SEARXNG_INSTANCE)

args.name: timeout
args.description: milliseconds before the request is given up on (default 10000)

qsm-web browserbox start.description: Start one container instance holding its own browser and live view

args.name: out
args.description: where this instance's artifacts land

args.name: dryRun
args.description: report the commands instead of running them

qsm-web browserbox ls.description: List the running instances with their live-view ports

args.name: dryRun
args.description: report the commands instead of running them

qsm-web browserbox stop.description: Stop one named instance, or every running one

args.name: name
args.description: the instance to stop (exclusive with --all)

args.name: all
args.description: stop every running instance

args.name: dryRun
args.description: report the commands instead of running them

qsm-web browserbox fetch.description: Open one address in an instance and report the page, with the artifacts asked for

args.name: url
args.description: the address to open

args.name: in
args.description: fetch inside this running instance instead of a fresh one

args.name: html
args.description: keep the rendered HTML

args.name: screenshot
args.description: keep a screenshot

args.name: cookies
args.description: keep the cookies

args.name: settle
args.description: milliseconds to wait after load before reading the page

args.name: timeout
args.description: milliseconds before the page is given up on

args.name: keep
args.description: leave the tab and its instance running afterwards

args.name: dryRun
args.description: report the commands instead of running them

qsm-web browserbox script.description: Run a step script inside an instance, filling any secret step from the vault

args.name: name
args.description: the instance to run the script in

args.name: file
args.description: the script file (exclusive with --steps)

args.name: steps
args.description: the script as inline JSON (exclusive with --file)

args.name: dryRun
args.description: report the commands instead of running them

qsm-web browserbox takeover.description: Hand one tab to a human and wait until the wall is cleared or the timeout passes

args.name: name
args.description: the instance holding the tab

args.name: tab
args.description: the tab to hand over

args.name: reason
args.description: what the human is being asked to clear

args.name: timeout
args.description: milliseconds to wait for the wall to be cleared

args.name: open
args.description: open the live view in the desktop browser

args.name: dryRun
args.description: report the commands instead of running them
